sn10.5:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Sāvatthiyam viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme || || Tena kho pana samayena aññatarissā upāsikāya Sānu nāma putto yakkhena gahito hoti || || Atha kho sā upasikā paridevamānā tāyaṃ velāyam imā gāthāyo abhāsi
sn10.5:3.1: uposatham upavasanti || brahmacariyaṃ caranti ye || na tehi yakkhā kīḷanti || iti me arahataṃ sutaṃ || || Sāṇuṃ pabuddhaṃ
sn10.5:6.1: vajjāsi || yakkhānaṃ vacanam idam || mā kāsi pāpakam kammam || āviṃ vā yadivā raho || ||
sn10.5:7.1: saceva pāpakaṃ kammaṃ || karissasi karosi vā || na te dukkhā pamuty-atthi || uppaccāpi palāyato ti || ||
sn10.5:8.1: Mataṃ va amma rodanti || yo vā jīvaṃ na dissati || jīvantam amma passantī || kasmā mam amma rodasīti || ||
sn10.5:9.1: Mataṃ va puttam rodanti || yo vā jīvam na dissati || yo ca kāmeva jitvāna || punar āgacchate idha || taṃ vāpi putta rodanti || puna jīvaṃ mato hi so || ||
sn10.5:10.1: kukkuḷā ubbhato tāta || kukkuḷam patitum icchasi || || narakā ubbhato tāta || narakam patitum icchasi ||
sn10.5:11.1: abhidhāvatha bhaddan-te || kassa ujjhāpayāmase || ādittā nibhataṃ bhaṇḍaṃ || puna ḍayhitum icchasīti || ||
